title: Iblis Is Banished
art: Iblis is shown only as a shadowed flame: no horns, no human face.
imagePrompt: A dark flame-like figure torn from a court of harsh white light and falling through layered bands of sky like a meteor of black smoke trailing ember sparks; as it falls it turns back, two burning points for eyes in the dark; storm-grey ink wash deepening to near-black.

beats.say: The light of the court turned against Iblis.
He was cast out, and his flame was torn from the heavens.

verse.en: Descend from Paradise, for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased.

beats.say: He fell through layer after layer of sky like a meteor of smoke.
As he fell, he turned back and made his vow.

verse.en: Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path.
Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left…
